letter.subject: Application for Senior Cloud & DevOps Engineer (Job ID: CS-8842)
paragraphs: I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Senior Cloud & DevOps Engineer position at CloudScale Systems. With over six years of hands-on experience designing cloud infrastructure, streamlining GitOps CI/CD delivery pipelines, and maintaining high-availability Kubernetes environments, I am excited by the prospect of contributing to your core infrastructure platform.

In my current role as Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer at NovaSphere Technologies, I architect multi-tenant Kubernetes clusters on AWS serving more than 15 million daily API requests. By introducing automated GitOps workflows via ArgoCD and GitHub Actions, my team reduced average deployment turnaround from 45 minutes to under 4 minutes while preserving 99.99% service availability. Furthermore, through automated Karpenter autoscaling and spot fleet optimization, I reduced infrastructure costs by 28%.

Beyond day-to-day operations, I am passionate about developer enablement and open-source tooling. I built and open-sourced KubeGuard, a real-time drift detection daemon written in Go, which reached over 1,200 GitHub stars and simplified multi-cluster compliance checks across distributed engineering teams. I take pride in building infrastructure that is not only robust and secure, but also intuitive for product developers to build upon.

CloudScale Systems' dedication to developer velocity, reliability, and modern cloud-native architectures resonates deeply with my background. I am eager to bring my expertise in Terraform, Kubernetes, observability, and infrastructure automation to your engineering team.
highlights: Cloud & Container Orchestration: Deep expertise with Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Docker, Helm, and Terraform infrastructure-as-code.
CI/CD & GitOps Automation: Proven track record slashing release cycle times using ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, and automated canary deployments.
Observability & Reliability: Hands-on implementation of OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, and distributed tracing to drastically reduce MTTD.
Automation & Tooling: Strong proficiency in Go, Python, and Bash for internal tooling, automated scaling, and cluster management.
letter.closing: Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my experience and approach to cloud reliability can support CloudScale Systems' growth.
letter.title: Senior Cloud & DevOps Engineer
